map.相关系数计算器。科学研究工具，采用标准科学公式，计算精准。: Compute the Pearson correlation coefficient from paired X and Y data to quantify the strength and direction of a linear relationship.
map.Pearson 相关系数 r ∈ [−1, 1]：衡量两个变量的线性相关程度与方: The Pearson correlation coefficient r ∈ [-1, 1] measures the strength and direction of the linear relationship between two variables and gives R² = r² (the proportion of explained variance); it is undefined when n<3 or either variance is 0.
map.X 数据集（逗号、空格或换行分隔）: X dataset (separated by commas, spaces, or newlines)
map.• r > 0：正相关；r < 0：负相关；r = 0：无相关: • r > 0: positive correlation; r < 0: negative correlation; r = 0: no correlation
map.相关 ≠ 因果；只衡量线性关系。: Correlation ≠ causation; it only measures linear relationships.
map.Pearson 线性相关强度。: The strength of Pearson linear correlation.
map.分析两组测量数据之间的线性关联强度。: Analyze the strength of the linear association between two sets of measurements.
map.x=[1,2,3,4]、y=[2,4,6,8] 完全线性 → r=1.0；y 随: x=[1,2,3,4], y=[2,4,6,8] is perfectly linear → r=1.0; if y is random then r≈0.
map.不等于，相关仅表线性关联。: No, correlation only indicates a linear association.
map.Pearson 只衡量线性关系，非线性可改用 Spearman 秩相关。: Pearson only measures linear relationships; for non-linear ones use Spearman rank correlation.
